name: LFG Dungeon Rewards
description: Quest rewards granted for completing a random dungeon via the Dungeon Finder. The first completion of the day rewards First Quest, consecutive completions reward Other Quest; rows are picked by the lowest Max Level not below the player level.

fields.name: Max Level
fields.help: Highest player level this reward row applies to.

fields.name: First Quest
fields.help: Quest rewarded on the first completion of the day.

fields.name: Other Quest
fields.help: Quest rewarded on consecutive completions of the day.
